2607.04750.title: FM-ChangeNet: Learning Change through Pathwise Feature Transport
2607.04750.paper_summary: We present FM-ChangeNet, a pathwise-supervised framework for change detection that reformulates bi-temporal reasoning as continuous transport in feature space rather than static endpoint comparison. Given encoded pre and post-temporal representations, we construct intermediate latent states and learn a time-conditioned velocity field $\hat{v}_θ(z_t,t)$ along the transformation trajectory. This pathwise formulation constrains the predictor over a continuum of intermediate states, providing a denser and less ambiguous supervision signal than conventional endpoint-only segmentation and enabling the model to capture temporal evolution explicitly. The learned velocity field is not only a transport mechanism but also an interpretable representation of change: its magnitude serves as a spatially localized change cue that helps distinguish true structural variation from nuisance effects such as illumination shifts and spatial misalignment. We develop a hierarchical multi-scale architecture with cross-temporal alignment, time-conditioned coarse-to-fine flow decoding, and a unified objective that couples flow supervision, trajectory consistency, spatial regularization, and segmentation loss. Experiments on remote sensing benchmarks show that the proposed framework produces more structured and robust change representations while achieving state-of-the-art performance.
2607.04750.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了FM-ChangeNet，一種基於路徑監督的變化檢測框架，將雙時序推理重新定義為特徵空間中的連續傳輸，而不是靜態的端點比較。<lb/>在編碼的前後時序表示下，我們構建了中間潛在狀態，並學習了沿變換軌跡的時間條件速度場 $\hat{v}_θ(z_t,t)$。<lb/>這種基於路徑的表述約束了預測器在一連串中間狀態上的表現，提供了比傳統僅基於端點的分割更密集且不模糊的監督信號，並使模型能夠明確捕捉時間演變。<lb/>學習到的速度場不僅是一種傳輸機制，也是變化的可解釋表示：其大小作為一種空間局部變化提示，有助於區分真實的結構變化與照明變化和空間錯位等干擾效應。<lb/>我們開發了一種層次多尺度架構，具有跨時間對齊、時間條件的粗到細流解碼，以及一個統一的目標，將流監督、軌跡一致性、空間正則化和分割損失結合在一起。<lb/>在遙感基準上的實驗顯示，所提出的框架產生了更具結構性和穩健性的變化表示，同時達到了最先進的性能。
